description_zh: 调用UpdateRemind更新自定义监控规则
name: UpdateRemind

parameters.help_en: The ID of the custom alert rule
parameters.name: remind_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the custom alert rule. The name cannot exceed 128 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 自定义规则的名称，不能超过128个字符
parameters.name: remind_name

parameters.help_en: The end time of the do-not-disturb period, before which no alerts are sent. Specify the time in the hh:mm format. Valid values for hh: [0,23]. Valid values for mm: [0,59]
parameters.help_zh: 免打扰的截止时间，即在设置的时间之前不会发送报警。格式为hh:mm。hh的取值范围为[0,23] ，mm的取值范围为[0,59]
parameters.name: dnd_end

parameters.help_en:
The type of the monitored object. Valid values:
NODE: node.
BASELINE: baseline.
PROJECT: workspace.
BIZPROCESS: workflow
parameters.help_zh:
监控对象的类型。取值如下：
NODE（节点）
BASELINE（基线）
PROJECT（工作空间）
BIZPROCESS（业务流程）
parameters.name: remind_unit

parameters.help_en: The node IDs when the monitored object is a node. A single rule supports monitoring up to 50 nodes. Separate multiple node IDs with commas (,). This parameter takes effect only when the RemindUnit parameter is set to NODE
parameters.help_zh:
监控对象为节点时的节点ID。一个规则最多监控50个节点，多个节点ID之间使用英文逗号（,）分隔。
当RemindUnit参数取值为NODE（节点）时，当前参数生效
parameters.name: node_ids

parameters.help_en: The baseline IDs when the monitored object is a baseline. A single rule supports monitoring up to 5 baselines. Separate multiple baseline IDs with commas (,). This parameter takes effect only when the RemindUnit parameter is set to BASELINE
parameters.help_zh:
监控对象为基线时的基线ID。一个规则最多监控5条基线，多个基线ID之间使用英文逗号（,）分隔。
当RemindUnit参数取值为BASELINE（基线）时，当前参数生效
parameters.name: baseline_ids

parameters.help_en: The workspace ID when the monitored object is a workspace. A single rule supports monitoring only one workspace. This parameter takes effect only when the RemindUnit parameter is set to PROJECT
parameters.help_zh:
监控对象为工作空间时的工作空间ID。一个规则只能监控一个工作空间。
当RemindUnit参数取值为PROJECT（工作空间）时，当前参数生效
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.help_en: The workflow IDs when the monitored object is a workflow. A single rule supports monitoring up to 5 workflows. Separate multiple workflow IDs with commas (,). This parameter takes effect only when the RemindUnit parameter is set to BIZPROCESS
parameters.help_zh:
监控对象为业务流程时的业务流程ID。一个规则最多监控5个业务流程，多个业务流程ID之间使用英文逗号（,）分隔。
当RemindUnit参数取值为BIZPROCESS（业务流程）时，当前参数生效
parameters.name: biz_process_ids

parameters.help_en:
The condition that triggers the alert rule. Valid values:
FINISHED: The system sends an alert when the task runs successfully. The monitoring starts from the time when the instance starts to run.
UNFINISHED: The system sends an alert if the task is still running at the specified time. The monitoring starts from the time when the instance starts to run.
ERROR: The system sends an alert when an error occurs while the task is running. The monitoring starts from the time when the instance starts to run.
CYCLE_UNFINISHED: The system sends an alert if the instance is still running within the specified cycle. This value is typically used to monitor instances that run on an hourly cycle.
TIMEOUT: The system sends an alert if the task is still running after the specified running duration. The monitoring starts from the time when the instance starts to run. This value is typically used to monitor the running duration of instances.

For more information about the conditions that trigger alert rules, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/138172.html
parameters.help_zh:
触发报警规则的条件。取值如下：
FINISHED（完成）：表示从实例运行的起始时间点开始监控，在任务运行成功时系统发送报警。
UNFINISHED（未完成）：表示从实例运行的起始时间点开始监控，到指定的目标时间点任务仍未结束运行，则系统发送报警。
ERROR（出错）：表示从实例运行的起始时间点开始监控，当任务运行出错时，系统发送报警。
CYCLE_UNFINISHED（周期未完成）：表示在指定的周期内，实例仍未结束运行，则系统发送报警。通常用于监控以小时为周期单位的实例任务。
TIMEOUT（运行超时）：表示从实例运行的起始时间点开始监控，到指定的运行时长后，该任务仍未结束运行，则系统发送报警。通常用于监控实例任务的运行时间。

更多触发报警规则的内容，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/138172.html
parameters.name: remind_type

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of alerts. Valid values: 1 to 10. Default value: 3
parameters.help_zh: 最大报警次数。取值范围为[1,10]，默认值为3
parameters.name: max_alert_times

parameters.help_en: The alert interval. Unit: seconds. Minimum value: 1200. Default value: 1800
parameters.help_zh: 报警间隔，单位为秒。最小值为1200，默认值为1800
parameters.name: alert_interval

parameters.help_en:
The details of the parameter settings for different conditional Causes:
When the RemindType (Cause) is set to FINISHED, the current parameter settings are empty.
When the RemindType (Cause) is set to UNFINISHED, the configuration format example for the current parameter settings is {"hour":23,"minu":59}. Valid values for hour: [0,47]. Valid values for minu: [0,59].
When the RemindType (Cause) is set to ERROR, the current parameter settings are empty.
When the RemindType (Cause) is set to CYCLE_UNFINISHED (epoch unfinished), the configuration format example for the current parameter settings is {"1":"05:50","2":"06:50","3":"07:50","4":"08:50","5":"09:50","6":"10:50","7":"11:50","8":"12:50","9":"13:50","10":"14:50","11":"15:50","12":"16:50","13":"17:50","14":"18:50","15":"19:50","16":"20:50","17":"21:50","18":"22:50","19":"23:50","20":"24:50","21":"25:50"}. The key in the JSON character string is the epoch number, with valid values of [1,288]. The value is the unfinished time corresponding to the epoch, in the hh:mm format. Valid values for hh: [0,47]. Valid values for mm: [0,59].
When the RemindType (Cause) is set to TIMEOUT, the configuration format example for the current parameter settings is 1800, in seconds. This means an alert is triggered if the instance runs for more than 30 minutes from the start
parameters.help_zh:
不同触发条件的参数配置详情，具体如下：
当RemindType（触发条件）取值为FINISHED（完成）时，当前参数配置为空。
当RemindType（触发条件）取值为UNFINISHED（未完成）时，当前参数的配置格式示例为{"hour":23,"minu":59}。hour的取值范围为[0,47]，minu的取值范围为[0,59]。
当RemindType（触发条件）取值为ERROR（出错）时，当前参数配置为空。
当RemindType（触发条件）取值为CYCLE_UNFINISHED（周期未完成）时，当前参数的配置格式示例为{"1":"05:50","2":"06:50","3":"07:50","4":"08:50","5":"09:50","6":"10:50","7":"11:50","8":"12:50","9":"13:50","10":"14:50","11":"15:50","12":"16:50","13":"17:50","14":"18:50","15":"19:50","16":"20:50","17":"21:50","18":"22:50","19":"23:50","20":"24:50","21":"25:50"}。
JSON字符串的key为周期号，取值范围为[1,288]；value为该周期对应的未完成时间，格式为hh:mm。hh的取值范围为[0,47]，mm的取值范围为[0,59]。
当RemindType（触发条件）取值为TIMEOUT（运行超时）时，当前参数的配置格式示例为1800，单位为秒。即从实例开始运行起，运行超过30分钟触发报警
parameters.name: detail

parameters.help_en: The recipients of the alert. Valid values: OWNER (task owner) and OTHER (specified users)
parameters.help_zh: 报警的接收对象，包括OWNER（任务责任人）和OTHER（指定的用户）
parameters.name: alert_unit

parameters.help_en:
The notification methods. Valid values:
MAIL: email.
SMS: text message.
PHONE: phone call. This method is supported only in DataWorks Professional Edition and higher.
DINGROBOTS: DingTalk chatbot. This method takes effect only after the RobotUrls parameter is configured.
Webhooks: WeCom or Lark chatbot. This method takes effect only after the Webhooks parameter is configured.

Separate multiple notification methods with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh:
报警的方式，取值如下：
MAIL（邮件）
SMS（短信）
PHONE（电话），仅DataWorks专业版及以上版本支持使用电话方式接收报警。
DINGROBOTS（钉钉机器人），仅当配置RobotUrls参数后，该报警方式才会生效。
Webhooks（企业微信或飞书机器人），仅当配置 Webhooks 参数后，该报警方式才会生效。

多个报警方式之间使用英文逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: alert_methods

parameters.help_en:
The details of the parameter settings for different alert recipients:
When the AlertUnit (alert recipient) is set to OWNER (task owner), the current parameter settings are empty.
When the AlertUnit (alert recipient) is set to OTHER (specified users), the current parameter settings are the Alibaba Cloud UIDs of the specified users. Separate multiple Alibaba Cloud UIDs with commas (,). You can specify up to 10 users to accept alerts
parameters.help_zh:
不同报警接收人的配置详情：
当AlertUnit（报警接收人）取值为OWNER（节点任务责任人）时，当前参数配置为空。
当AlertUnit（报警接收人）取值为OTHER（指定的用户）时，当前参数配置为指定用户的阿里云UID。多个阿里云UID之间使用英文逗号（,）分隔，最多支持指定10个用户接收报警
parameters.name: alert_targets

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the alert rule. Valid values:
true: enables the alert rule.
false: disables the alert rule
parameters.help_zh:
是否启用报警规则，取值如下：
true（开启）
false（关闭）
parameters.name: use_flag

parameters.help_en: The webhook URLs of the DingTalk group chatbot. Separate multiple webhook URLs with commas (,). When the parameter settings are set to undefined, the system clears the webhook URLs of the DingTalk chatbot
parameters.help_zh:
钉钉群机器人的WebHook地址，多个WebHook地址之间使用英文逗号（,）分隔。
当该参数配置为undefined时，系统会清空钉钉机器人的WebHook地址
parameters.name: robot_urls

parameters.help_en:
The webhook URLs of the WeCom or Lark chatbot. Separate multiple webhook URLs with commas (,). The alertMethods parameter must include the WEBHOOKS alerting method. When the parameter settings are set to undefined, the system clears the webhook URLs.

Supported only in DataWorks Enterprise Edition.
Available regions: China (Shanghai), China (Chengdu), China (Zhangjiakou), China (Beijing), China (Hangzhou), China (Shenzhen), China (Hong Kong), Germany (Frankfurt), and Asia-Pacific Southeast 1 (Singapore)
parameters.help_zh:
企业微信或飞书机器人的webhook地址，多个webhook地址之间使用英文逗号（,）分隔。alertMethods 中需要包含 WEBHOOKS 告警方式。当该参数配置为undefined时，系统会清空WebHook地址。

仅DataWorks企业版支持。
可用地域：华东2（上海）、西南1（成都）、华北3（张家口）、华北2（北京）、华东1（杭州）、华南1（深圳）、中国（香港）、欧洲中部 1（法兰克福）、亚太东南1（新加坡）
parameters.name: webhooks
